method.readout: Constrain the next token to exact one-character option IDs and renormalize their probability mass; this can change argmax decisions.
method.training: No additional training for the choice-token readout.
method.option_ids: A-Z followed by a-z; at most 52 options.
method.calibration: Scalar temperature changes probabilities but not argmax accuracy.
method.ensemble: Native + choice configurations use log-linear/geometric pooling.

zero_shot.meaning: No Typed, JevJudge, JevBench, or Transfer-test labels tune the readout configuration.

transfer_dev_tuned.meaning: Weight and additional temperature are selected only on Transfer-v9 development, then frozen for every displayed evaluation panel.
transfer_dev_tuned.accuracy_note: Temperature-only calibrated choice has the same hard accuracy as choice_t1; only a changed blend weight can change its argmax.

predictor.prompt: Cygnet-compatible A-Z; extended with a-z above 26 options
predictor.long_context_attention: fused SDPA (Flash/Efficient, no math fallback) at or above the recorded threshold; exact math SDPA below it

evaluation_protocol.blend_selection: not performed here; components are saved for fitting on Transfer-v9 development only
evaluation_protocol.efficiency_scope: base calls execute choice only; checkpoint calls execute choice and native. Do not compare component efficiency from these end-to-end timings
evaluation_protocol.long_context_attention: exact math SDPA below the configured threshold; memory-linear fused SDPA without a math fallback at or above it

ensemble_protocol.selection_split: Transfer-v9 development clean/knowable accuracy cohort; never any reported test panel
ensemble_protocol.temperature_fit: bounded scalar NLL minimization, T in [0.05, 20]
ensemble_protocol.ece: 15 equal-width bins for Typed Decisions; 10 for every other dataset
ensemble_protocol.selection_objective: accuracy; calibrated NLL then distance from 0.5 break ties
ensemble_protocol.transfer: the selected weight and temperature are frozen for every held-out dataset
ensemble_protocol.native_shipped: the checkpoint's native probabilities, including its shipped inference temperature; no additional temperature is applied
ensemble_protocol.fixed_blend_0_5: equal log-linear pooling of T=1 choice probabilities and shipped native probabilities; no additional temperature is applied
ensemble_protocol.transfer_dev_tuned_blend: the Transfer-dev-selected native weight followed by the reported scalar additional temperature
